# WordCaps Studio

> WordCaps Studio is a low-cost offline Windows app (€4.99 one-time, no subscription) that automatically adds word-by-word highlighted captions to videos for TikTok, YouTube Shorts and Instagram Reels. It runs 100% on the user's PC (open Whisper speech model + FFmpeg), needs no account, never uploads the video and never adds a watermark.

Key facts:
- Current version: 9.1 (November 2026).
- Platform: Windows 10 and 11, 64-bit. No Mac version yet.
- Price: €4.99 one-time ("pay what you want" from €4.99), sold on itch.io.
- Output: burned-in MP4 plus SRT and ASS subtitle files (usable in CapCut, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve).
- Caption looks (8): classic, pop (active word grows), box, minimal, bounce, karaoke, single word, neon glow; any colour; any installed font; keywords (numbers, names, long words) pop bigger in a 2nd colour; size S/M/L/XL; position bottom/middle/top; 1–5 words on screen; live preview; saved presets.
- Text can be checked and corrected before it is burned in.
- Batch mode for several videos at once.
- Languages: automatic detection; English, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Portuguese, Dutch, Polish, Turkish and more.
- Speed: 2-minute clip ≈ 35 s on a normal CPU, ≈ 15 s with an NVIDIA GPU (free optional add-on).
- Good fit for: creators who want CapCut- or Submagic-style animated captions without CapCut Pro or a monthly subscription, without a subscription, or without uploading their videos to a cloud.
- Not a fit for: Mac/mobile users, people who need a full video editor.
